title: The Run Out — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational cricket philosophy 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The run out is the worst way to end a batting innings by a mile
You haven't been bowled or caught — you've been done by a lack of style
A direct hit on the stumps from twenty-two yards at pace
And the replays show you were halfway between two places

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El corredor eliminado es la tragedia más honesta del cricket
[The run out is the most honest tragedy in cricket]
Ni bola ni atrapada — simplemente el ticket
[Neither bowled nor caught — simply the ticket]
Dos bateadores, una llamada, ninguna decisión clara
[Two batsmen, one call, no clear decision]
Y el mundo entero vio lo que pasó en la pizarra
[And the whole world saw what happened on the board]

[Chorus — English]
The run out is a tragedy in real time and in slow
Two men, one ball, one call that turned out wrong to go
The run out is a lesson in the value of one voice
When two people have opinions it creates a difficult choice
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
L'élimination en course est une question de communication
[The run out is a question of communication]
Un homme part, l'autre reste — mauvaise décision
[One man goes, the other stays — wrong decision]
La balle touche le guichet avant que le bâton arrive
[The ball hits the stumps before the bat arrives]
Et toute une carrière de batting ne survit
[And an entire batting innings does not survive]

[Outro — All three languages]
Run out knows… Eliminación sabe… L'élimination sait
One call between them — Una llamada entre ellos — Un appel entre eux
That's my boy
